description: A font: a source font encoded into a distance field atlas and a layout JSON.

__schema0.description: The JSON Schema in .schemas/ an editor validates this file with. The gatherer ignores it.

__schema1.description: The id. Default: the file name without .font.json.

__schema5.description: The source font, relative to this JSON ("./IBMPlexSans-Medium.woff"): a static TTF, OTF or WOFF (no WOFF2, no variable font).

__schema6.description: The atlas type: MTSDF (sharp corners and a true distance for soft effects), MSDF (sharp corners only) or SDF (the true distance alone). Default: MTSDF.

__schema8.description: The em's size in atlas pixels (8-512). Default: 48.

__schema10.description: The distance range in atlas pixels, its full width (8: ±4 px around the outline). Wider allows thicker outlines and glows. Default: 8.

__schema12.description: The characters the atlas holds. Space and the fallback glyph are always in; one the font lacks is dropped with a warning.

__schema13.description: Named sets of characters. Default: ["ASCII"] without a charset, [] in a charset that leaves it out.

__schema15.description: More characters, each in once however often it's written.

__schema17.description: JSON or text files relative to this JSON: every character of a text file, and of every string in a JSON file (keys and values).

__schema19.description: Adds the characters of every text a scene writes with this font. Default: false.

__schema21.description: The character drawn for one the atlas lacks; always in the atlas. Default: "?".

__schema23.description: Writes the font's kerning between the atlas's characters into the layout. Default: true.

__schema25.description: The atlas page's size limits and the space around each glyph.

__schema26.description: The largest side in pixels, a power of two (64-8192). The atlas grows to it, and the encode fails past it. Default: 2048.

__schema28.description: Empty pixels around each glyph's field, so a bilinear tap never reads a neighbour. Default: 2.

__schema30.description: Both sides powers of two. Default: true.
